text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait… Yeah, that's right. That's right! There's more than one race out there, and more than one track to run on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I don't need to run for glory under a bunch of pressure. There's a freer path as well.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Like…)

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pal-mer! Pal-mer! Pal-mer! Pal-mer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Like where it all started—where I found my joy of running!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios! Trainer! I think I wanna run in freestyle races again!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For real?! So you wanna kiss the Twinkle Series goodbye?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nah. I wanna run in both. I might have to choose one eventually, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Is that okay with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Judging from the look in her eyes, I can tell she's serious. For the sake of her future, I approve her request.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (It's been so long since I've run in a freestyle race! The vibes here just hit different!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Everything is just fire! No chains, no responsibility—just a place to get pumped up and slay!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah! Time for takeoff! Let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Everyone's amped when they win and devastated when they lose…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Waheeey! ☆ Great job, everyone! Now, let's sing our hearts out!

text_block_list.name: Freestyle Racer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Time to party! No one's going home 'cause they gotta train or anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Now these are my people. Once the race is over, everyone's ready to cut loose.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I've got everything I need here! Yeah!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This is the best! I've got zero complaints!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (It's the best… Right?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One night, while walking around an empty training area at Tracen Academy…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh… Hey, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Palmer? What are you doing here?
Palmer? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just doing some thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And looking past this fence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no need for her to explain any further. Beyond the fence lies the familiar sight of the track where she always runs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: On the other side of that fence lies a world that doesn't mesh with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The expectations out there weigh me down and the pressure is ridiculous!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'd rather not go over there if I don't have to, and… well, I don't have to. I can just do whatever I want.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But… still… It's like…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It feels like I'm missing something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I hate tough things, you know? Things'd be way easier if I just avoided them and lived my life. But despite that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Standing up to that enormous pressure somehow even though you're, like, on the verge shattering under its weight…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's like ohhhhh man! It feels sooo good, I just can't get it out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gyaaahhh! I'm such a dummy. I must be seriously out of my mind if I can't even calculate these risks and benefits right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But, y'know… No matter how painful it is, no matter how heavy the pressure, I wanna feel those expectations…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: When I was a kid, it was a world I could never set my sights on. Now I'm finally in a place where I can stand side by side with McQueen and Ryan and see everything firsthand…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And now that I'm here, I want people to be like, "She's got this!" "She'll surprise us!" or "She's gonna bring the vibes!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So I dunno what to do. Should I stick with freestyle races? Or…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Or should I…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There is a fence in front of Mejiro Palmer—one she doesn't particularly need to go over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But in order for her to decide whether or not she wants to climb over it, there's something she must know.
choice_data_list: What kind of Umamusume do you want to be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What… kind of Umamusume?
choice_data_list: Yeah. What kind of Umamusume is Mejiro Palmer?
Yeah. What kind of Umamusume is Mejiro Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Who is the real Mejiro Palmer that I want to be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I'm good with just being all right. I don't need to be as good as Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I mean, I'm more like some rando in the background, anyway. Ahahaha…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I'm not just some rando.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I just pretended I didn't believe in myself and ran away.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (If I decide something's impossible, then impossible it can stay.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This is the best! I've got zero complaints! Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Freestyle races are the best. There's no doubt about that. Everything about them is pure freedom…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (But what I want is…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (The real freedom I want is…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The freedom on the other side of the fence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There're a lot of things that'll tie you down, and the pressure is immense. And so are the expectations! But even so!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I wanna be someone who's free within all of that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If someone looks down on me, or if I look down on myself… I want to be someone who can brush it right off, kick them to the curb, and tell myself I'm the best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I want the kind of freedom where nothing can tie me down! That's…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's the Mejiro Palmer I wanna be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says it with conviction. There's only one path, one lane ahead of her. In that case…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Jump what? The fence?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's jump this fence and jump back into the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: The world I used to be a part of is on the other side of this fence. But even if I do jump over and go back…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I won't be the same person I was before. I'll be the me who chose to go back of her own free will…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even though I was never any good and I tripped on every hurdle life threw at me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll be someone who chose to go back, despite all that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer puts some distance between her and the fence. And then…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh! Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gets a running start and makes a huge leap! The moon looks so big, framing her as she goes over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… I… did it. Even though it was sooo high!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And with a perfect landing, I might add!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, but it's kinda weird for you to welcome me back like that. I mean, you're gonna follow me wherever I go, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And it's not like I've come back to where you were.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've come back to where I belong. I've finally realized that this track is where I belong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Palmer comes back to the Twinkle Series. We tell Daitaku Helios, and…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, seriously? It must be a bit painful, but I guess you're back in the Twinkle Series then. I guess that means—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's right. It's best to experience both pain and pleasure. I finally figured that out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's not what I was gonna say. What I'm trying to say is…

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're kind of a masochist, huh, Palmster?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A masochist?! What do you mean by that?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's not like I like pain or anything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Suuure you don't. ☆ I hit the nail on the head, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Urghhh… No. Well, maybe you're not totally wrong… I guess…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer is a little flustered. All the same, her deliberation has led her to clearing a major hurdle in her life.
